questions.question: A boat can row 24 km in 6 hours in still water. It can row 56 km downstream and 30 km upstream in 38 hours. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In still water, 

Distance = 24 km ; Time = 6 hrs.

Downstream distance = 56 km

Upstream distance = 30 km

Total time taken = 38 hrs.

**Concept used:**

Downstream speed = U + V

Upstream speed = U - V

Where, U = speed of a boat in still water

V = speed of stream

**Formula used:**

Distance = speed × time

(a + b)(a - b) = a² - b²

**Calculation:**

Speed of boat in still water (U) = Distance/time

⇒ 24/6 = 4 km/h

According to the question:

⇒ 56/(U + V) + 30/(U - V) = 38

⇒ 56/(4 + V) + 30/(4 - V) = 38

⇒ {56× (4 - V) + 30 × (4 + V)}/(4 + V)(4 - V) = 38

⇒ 224 - 26V + 120 = 38 × (4² - V²)

⇒ 344 - 26V = 38 × (16 - V2)

⇒ 344 - 26V = 608 - 38V2

⇒ 38V2 - 26V - 264 = 0

⇒ 19V2 - 13V - 132 = 0

⇒ 19V2 - 57V + 44V - 132 = 0

⇒ 19V(V - 3) + 44(V - 3) = 0

⇒ (V - 3) (19V + 44) = 0

⇒ (V - 3) = 0 

⇒ V = 3 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 km/hr.**

questions.question:
The pie chart given below shows the production of wheat by six states. The total production of wheat by all these six states is 3600. The production of wheat of a particular state is shown in terms of degree with respect to the total production of wheat by all these six states.

What is the difference between average production of wheat by P and Q and the average production of wheat by R and T?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96d890a51ef1c5f6aa4c6829a759cd15640b05655d08267e13dbc4bbe868db18.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total production of wheat by 6 states = 360° = 3600

⇒ 1° = 10

Production of state P = 110° = 110 × 10 = 1100

Production of state Q = 70° = 70 × 10 = 700

Average production by state P & Q = (1100 + 700)/2 = 900

Production of state R = 80° = 80 × 10 = 800

Production of state T = 20° = 20 × 10 = 200

Average production by state R & T = (800 + 200)/2 = 500

Difference between the average production of P and Q and R & T = 900 - 500 = 400

**∴ The correct answer is 400.**

questions.question: The amount received on a certain sum after 3 years and 5 years on compound interest (compounding annually) is Rs. 20,736 and Rs. 29,859.84 respectively. What is that sum?
questions.solution:
Given:

The amount received on a certain sum after 3 years and 5 years on compound interest (compounding annually) is Rs. 20,736 and Rs. 29,859.84 respectively. 

Formula used:

In compound interest,

Amount = Principal × (1 + r / 100)n

Calculation:

As per the question,

​⇒ 29,859.84 / 20,736 = Principal × (1 + r / 100)⁵ / Principal × (1 + r / 100)³

⇒ (1 + r / 100)5 / (1 + r / 100)³ = 29,859.84 / 20,736 

​⇒ (1 + r / 100)² = 1.44

​⇒ 1 + r / 100) = 1.2

​⇒ r / 100 = 1.2 - 1

​⇒ r = 20%

As per the question,

​⇒ 20,736 = Principal × (1 + 20 / 100)³

​⇒ Principal = (20,736 × 5 ×5×5)/6 × 6 × 6

⇒ Principal = 12000

**∴ The correct option is 4**

questions.question: P is thrice as good as workman as Q and therefore is able to finish a work in 40 days less than Q. In how many days can they together complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given: 

P is thrice as good as a workman as Q 

He is able to finish work in 40 days less than Q

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of Q is x,

So the efficiency of P is 3x

So P takes x days then Q takes 3x days.

As per the question,

⇒ 3x - x = 40

⇒ 2x = 40

⇒ x = 20

So P takes 20 days then Q takes 3 × 20 = 60 days.

Let the total work is the 60 units (LCM of 20 and 60)

they together complete the same work in

⇒ 60 / (3+1)

⇒ 60 / 4

= 15 days

**∴ The correct option is 3** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] __Additional Information__Efficiency of a person is inversely proportional to number of days to complete the work.

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 2600 is invested in a scheme of simple interest. It becomes Rs. 3320 in 3 years. How much this sum will become in 5 years?
questions.solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 2600

Time = 3 years

Amount = Rs. 3320

Formula:

Simple interest = PRT/100

Here, P is the Principal, R is the rate of interest and T is time in years

Calculation:

Simple interest = Amount - Principal

Simple interest for 3 years = 3320 - 2600

⇒ 720

Simple interest for 1 year = 720 / 3

⇒ 240

Simple interest for 5 years = 5 × 240

⇒ 1200

The sum after 5 years will be:

⇒ 2600 (initial principal) + 1200 (5 years interest)

⇒ 3800.

**The sum after 5 years will be 3800**

questions.question: The ratio of the sides of a triangle is 3 ∶ 3 ∶ 4. If the area of triangle is 32√5 cm², then what is the length of the equal sides?
questions.solution:
Given:

Sides ratio of a triangle = 3 : 3 : 4

Area of the triangle = 32√5 cm²

Formula:

Area of triangle = √[s (s - a) (s - b) (s - c)]

Semi-perimeter = (a + b + c)/2

The perimeter of the triangle = a + b + c

Calculation:

Sides ratio of triangle = 3x : 3x : 4x

⇒ s = (3x + 3x + 4x)/2

⇒ s = 10x/2 = 5x

Area of triangle = √ [5x × (5x - 3x) × (5x - 3x) × (5x - 4x)]

⇒ 32√5 = √ [5x × 2x × 2x × x]

⇒ 32√5 = 2√5x²

⇒ 2x² = 32

⇒ x² = 16

⇒ x = √16

⇒ x = 4

⇒ 3x → 12

**The length of the equal sides is 12 cm.**

questions.question: Marked price of an article is Rs. 1200. A discount of 40 percent is given. If there is a loss of 20 percent, then what is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Marked Price = 1200

Discount = 40%

Loss = 20%

**Formula used:-**

Selling Price = Marked Price (1 – discount%/100)

Selling Price = Cost Price (1 - Loss%/100)

**Calculation:-**

∵ M.P. = 1200 and discount% = 40% 

⇒ S.P. = 1200(1 – 40/100) = 720

⇒ S.P. = C.P. (1 - 20/100)

⇒ C.P. = (720/80) × 100 = 900. 

**∴ The required answer is__ 900__.**

 A ∶ B ∶ C = 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 4

So, A = 2k, B = 3k, and C = 4k. 

⇒ (A/B) ∶ (B/C) ∶ (C/A). = (2k) / (3k) :(3k) / (4k):(4k) / (2k)

questions.question: The average height of P, Q and R is 160 cm. If the average height of P and Q is 140 cm and that of Q and R is 129 cm, then what is the height of Q?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

The average height of P, Q, and R is 160 cm 

The average height of P and Q is 140 cm 

The average height of R and Q is 129 cm

**Formula used:-** 

Average = Sum of Values/Number of Values

**Calculation:- ** 

⇒ (P + Q + R)/3 = 160 

⇒ (P + Q + R) = 480 

Similarly, 

⇒ (P + Q)/2 = 140 

⇒ (P + Q) = 280

⇒ R = (P + Q + R) - (P + Q) 

⇒ R = 480 - 280 = 200 

Similarly, 

⇒ (Q + R)/2 = 129 

⇒ Q + R = 258 

⇒ Q = 258 - 200 = 58 cm 

**∴**** The required answer is __58__ cm.**
